package contract_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"

	contract "__CONTRACT_IMPORT__"
	protogen "__PROTOGEN_IMPORT__"

	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"gotest.tools/v3/assert"
)

type transportSource struct {
	reads atomic.Int32
}

func (s *transportSource) Recv() (*contract.Chunk, error) {
	s.reads.Add(1)
	return &contract.Chunk{Value: 1}, nil
}

type transportStream struct {
	ctx         context.Context
	entered     chan struct{}
	release     <-chan struct{}
	finalErr    error
	enteredOnce sync.Once
}

func (s *transportStream) Header() (metadata.MD, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (s *transportStream) Trailer() metadata.MD {
	return nil
}

func (s *transportStream) CloseSend() error {
	return nil
}

func (s *transportStream) Context() context.Context {
	return s.ctx
}

func (s *transportStream) SendMsg(any) error {
	s.enteredOnce.Do(func() { close(s.entered) })
	<-s.release
	return io.EOF
}

func (s *transportStream) RecvMsg(any) error {
	return s.finalErr
}

type transportConn struct {
	stream *transportStream
}

func (c *transportConn) Invoke(context.Context, string, any, any, ...grpc.CallOption) error {
	return status.Error(codes.Unimplemented, "unexpected unary RPC")
}

func (c *transportConn) NewStream(ctx context.Context, _ *grpc.StreamDesc, _ string, _ ...grpc.CallOption) (grpc.ClientStream, error) {
	c.stream.ctx = ctx
	return c.stream, nil
}

func TestClientStreamingTransportBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		parent, cancelParent := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		t.Cleanup(cancelParent)

		release := newRelease()
		finalErr := detailError(codes.PermissionDenied, "transport final status", "TRANSPORT_FINAL")
		stream := &transportStream{
			entered:  make(chan struct{}),
			release:  release.ch,
			finalErr: finalErr,
		}
		conn := &transportConn{stream: stream}
		client := protogen.NewClient(conn)
		source := &transportSource{}
		result := make(chan uploadResult, 1)
		done := make(chan struct{})
		go func() {
			reply, err := client.Upload(parent, source)
			result <- uploadResult{reply: reply, err: err}
			close(done)
		}()
		t.Cleanup(func() {
			release.Close()
			<-done
		})

		<-stream.entered
		synctest.Wait()
		assert.Equal(t, source.reads.Load(), int32(1))
		select {
		case <-done:
			t.Fatal("Upload completed while SendMsg was blocked")
		default:
		}

		release.Close()
		got := <-result
		assert.Assert(t, got.reply == nil)
		assertDetail(t, got.err, codes.PermissionDenied, "transport final status", "TRANSPORT_FINAL")
		assert.Assert(t, proto.Equal(status.Convert(got.err).Proto(), status.Convert(finalErr).Proto()))
		assert.Equal(t, source.reads.Load(), int32(1))
		assert.Equal(t, stream.ctx.Err(), context.Canceled)
		assert.NilError(t, parent.Err())
	})
}
